chapterInfo.content:
9
Onyankopɔn yi Israelfoɔ
1Mereka nokorɛ no Kristo mu, menni atorɔ, na m’ahonim nso redi me adanseɛ Honhom Kronkron mu 2sɛ: Medi awerɛhoɔ kɛseɛ ne daa yea wɔ m’akoma mu. 3#Eks 32.32 Na anka mepɛ sɛ wɔyi me ara firi Kristo ho, yɛ abusudeɛ ma me nuanom a honam fam wɔyɛ m’abusuafoɔ, 4#Eks 4.22; Deut 7.6; 14.1 na wɔyɛ Israelfoɔ a abayɛ ne animuonyam, ne apam ahodoɔ ne mmarahyɛ ne nyamesom ne bɔhyɛ ahodoɔ no yɛ wɔn dea; 5#Mat 1; Luk 3.23-34; Yoh 1.1 na agyanom no nso wɔ wɔn, na honam fam no, Kristo a ɔyɛ ade nyinaa so Nyankopɔn a wɔhyira no daa daa no firi wɔn mu bae. Amen.
6 # Num 23.19; Rom 2.28 Na ɛnyɛ sɛ ebia Nyankopɔn asɛm no mu atu. Ɛfiri sɛ ɛnyɛ wɔn a wɔfiri Israel mu nyinaa na wɔyɛ Israelfoɔ, 7#Gye 21.12 nanso ɛnyɛ sɛ wɔyɛ Abraham asefoɔ nti, wɔn nyinaa yɛ Abraham mma, na mmom: Isak mu na wɔbɛfrɛ w’asefoɔ. 8#Gal 4.23 Ɛne sɛ, ɛnyɛ honam mma no ne Nyankopɔn mma, na mmom bɔhyɛ mma no na wɔbu wɔn asefoɔ. 9#Gye 18.10 Ɛfiri sɛ bɔhyɛ asɛm no ni: Afeda sɛsɛɛ mɛba, na Sara anya ɔba. 10#Gye 25.21 Na ɛnyɛ yei nko, na Rebeka nso ne ɔbaakofoɔ a ɔne yɛn agya Isak no nyinsɛneeɛ, 11na ɔnnya nwoo mma no, na wɔnnya nyɛɛ papa anaa bɔne no, deɛ ɛbɛyɛ na Onyankopɔn tiri mu a ɔbɔɔ no nyiyimu soɔ no atena hɔ, na amfiri nnwuma mu, na mmom ɛnam ne frɛ so nti, 12#Gye 25.23 wɔsee no sɛ: Ɔpanin no bɛsom akumaa no; 13#Mal 1.2-3 sɛdeɛ wɔatwerɛ sɛ:
Medɔɔ Yakob,
na metanee Esau.
14 # Deut 32.4 Enti afei yɛbɛka sɛn? Adeɛ a ɛntene wɔ Nyankopɔn hɔ anaa? Dabi da! 15#Eks 33.19 Na ɔsee Mose sɛ:
Deɛ mehu no mmɔbɔ no ara na mɛhu no mmɔbɔ,
na deɛ me yam hyehye me ma no no ara na me yam bɛhyehye me ama no.
16 # Efe 2.8 Ɛnneɛ na ɛmfiri deɛ ɔpɛ anaa deɛ ɔtu mmirika no, na mmom ɛfiri Onyankopɔn a ɔhunu mmɔborɔ no. 17#Eks 9.16 Na atwerɛ no see Farao sɛ: Yei ara nti na mama wo so sɛ mɛyi me tumi adi wɔ wo mu, na wɔabɔ me din asase nyinaa so. 18#Eks 4.21 Ɛnneɛ na deɛ ɔpɛ na ɔhu no mmɔborɔ, na deɛ ɔpɛ na ɔma n’akoma yɛ den.
Onyankopɔn abufuo ne n’ahummɔborɔ
19Na afei wobɛka akyerɛ me sɛ: Adɛn na ɔda so nunu onipa? Na hwan na ɔbɛtumi ne ne pɛ a ɔpɛ no adi asie? 20#Yes 45.9 Ɛnneɛ, onipa, hwan ne wo a wotuatua Onyankopɔn asɛm ano? Anwonneɛ bɛse ɔnwomfoɔ sɛ: Adɛn nti na woyɛɛ me sɛɛ? 21Okukunwomfoɔ nni dɔteɛ so tumi sɛ ɔde dɔtetoa korɔ no ara nwono kukuo baako ma no yɛ fɛ na ɔnwono foforɔ nso a ɛnyɛ fɛ? 22#Rom 2.4 Na sɛ Onyankopɔn pɛ sɛ ɔyi n’abufuo adi, na ɔma wɔhunu ne tumidie, nanso ɔde abodwokyɛre bebree kuraa abufuo adeɛ a wɔasiesie ama ɔsɛeɛ no mu, 23#Efe 1.3-12; Rom 8.29 sɛ ɔbɛma wɔahunu n’animuonyam ahonya nso mmɔborɔhunu adeɛ a wɔasiesie ama animuonyam no so a, wobɛka sɛn? 24Yɛn nso wafrɛ yɛn, ɛnyɛ Yudafoɔ nko ara mu, na amanaman mufoɔ nso.
25 # Hos 2.23 Sɛdeɛ ɔka no Hosea nwoma mu nso sɛ:
Mɛfrɛ wɔn a wɔnyɛ me man no “me man,”
ne deɛ mannɔ no no ɔdɔfo;
26 # Hos 1.10 na ɛbɛba sɛ faako a wɔsee wɔn sɛ: Monyɛ me man no,
ɛhɔ ara na wɔbɛfrɛ wɔn Nyankopɔn Teasefoɔ no mma.
27 # Yes 10.22-23; Rom 11.5 Yesaia nso tea mu wɔ Israel ho sɛ: Sɛ Israel mma dodoɔ te sɛ mpoano anwea a, emu nkaeɛ no na wɔbɛgye wɔn nkwa; 28ɛfiri sɛ Awurade bɛdi n’asɛm asase so awie atwa no tiaa. 29#Yes 1.9 Na sɛdeɛ Yesaia aka asie no:
Sɛ asafo Awurade annya mma amma yɛn a,
anka yɛayɛ sɛ Sodom, na wɔama yɛasɛ Gomora.
Paulo mpaeɛ a ɔbɔ ma Israel
30 # Rom 10.20 Enti afei yɛbɛka sɛn? Amanaman mufoɔ a wɔanti tenenee no anya tenenee, nanso ɛyɛ tenenee a ɛfiri gyidie mu; 31#Rom 10.2-3 na Israel a wɔtii tenenee mmara no deɛ, wɔanto tenenee mmara no. 32Ɛdeɛn ntira? Ɛfiri sɛ wɔtii no sɛ ɛmfiri gyidie mu, na mmom ɛfiri nnwuma mu; ɛfiri sɛ wɔsuntii suntiboɔ no, 33#Yes 8.14; 28.16; Mat 21.42; 21.44 sɛdeɛ wɔatwerɛ sɛ:
Hwɛ, mede ɔbotan bi resi Sion a ɛbɛyɛ suntiboɔ ama nnipa, ɛyɛ ɔbotan a ɛbɛma wɔn ahweaseɛ;
na obiara a ɔbɛgye no adie no anim rengu ase.

Mereka nokorɛ no Kristo mu, menni atorɔ, na m’ahonim nso redi me adanseɛ Honhom Kronkron mu sɛ: Medi awerɛhoɔ kɛseɛ ne daa yea wɔ m’akoma mu. Na anka mepɛ sɛ wɔyi me ara firi Kristo ho, yɛ abusudeɛ ma me nuanom a honam fam wɔyɛ m’abusuafoɔ, na wɔyɛ Israelfoɔ a abayɛ ne animuonyam, ne apam ahodoɔ ne mmarahyɛ ne nyamesom ne bɔhyɛ ahodoɔ no yɛ wɔn dea; na agyanom no nso wɔ wɔn, na honam fam no, Kristo a ɔyɛ ade nyinaa so Nyankopɔn a wɔhyira no daa daa no firi wɔn mu bae. Amen.
Na ɛnyɛ sɛ ebia Nyankopɔn asɛm no mu atu. Ɛfiri sɛ ɛnyɛ wɔn a wɔfiri Israel mu nyinaa na wɔyɛ Israelfoɔ, nanso ɛnyɛ sɛ wɔyɛ Abraham asefoɔ nti, wɔn nyinaa yɛ Abraham mma, na mmom: Isak mu na wɔbɛfrɛ w’asefoɔ. Ɛne sɛ, ɛnyɛ honam mma no ne Nyankopɔn mma, na mmom bɔhyɛ mma no na wɔbu wɔn asefoɔ. Ɛfiri sɛ bɔhyɛ asɛm no ni: Afeda sɛsɛɛ mɛba, na Sara anya ɔba. Na ɛnyɛ yei nko, na Rebeka nso ne ɔbaakofoɔ a ɔne yɛn agya Isak no nyinsɛneeɛ, na ɔnnya nwoo mma no, na wɔnnya nyɛɛ papa anaa bɔne no, deɛ ɛbɛyɛ na Onyankopɔn tiri mu a ɔbɔɔ no nyiyimu soɔ no atena hɔ, na amfiri nnwuma mu, na mmom ɛnam ne frɛ so nti, wɔsee no sɛ: Ɔpanin no bɛsom akumaa no; sɛdeɛ wɔatwerɛ sɛ:
Medɔɔ Yakob,
na metanee Esau.
Enti afei yɛbɛka sɛn? Adeɛ a ɛntene wɔ Nyankopɔn hɔ anaa? Dabi da! Na ɔsee Mose sɛ:
Deɛ mehu no mmɔbɔ no ara na mɛhu no mmɔbɔ,
na deɛ me yam hyehye me ma no no ara na me yam bɛhyehye me ama no.
Ɛnneɛ na ɛmfiri deɛ ɔpɛ anaa deɛ ɔtu mmirika no, na mmom ɛfiri Onyankopɔn a ɔhunu mmɔborɔ no. Na atwerɛ no see Farao sɛ: Yei ara nti na mama wo so sɛ mɛyi me tumi adi wɔ wo mu, na wɔabɔ me din asase nyinaa so. Ɛnneɛ na deɛ ɔpɛ na ɔhu no mmɔborɔ, na deɛ ɔpɛ na ɔma n’akoma yɛ den.

Na afei wobɛka akyerɛ me sɛ: Adɛn na ɔda so nunu onipa? Na hwan na ɔbɛtumi ne ne pɛ a ɔpɛ no adi asie? Ɛnneɛ, onipa, hwan ne wo a wotuatua Onyankopɔn asɛm ano? Anwonneɛ bɛse ɔnwomfoɔ sɛ: Adɛn nti na woyɛɛ me sɛɛ? Okukunwomfoɔ nni dɔteɛ so tumi sɛ ɔde dɔtetoa korɔ no ara nwono kukuo baako ma no yɛ fɛ na ɔnwono foforɔ nso a ɛnyɛ fɛ? Na sɛ Onyankopɔn pɛ sɛ ɔyi n’abufuo adi, na ɔma wɔhunu ne tumidie, nanso ɔde abodwokyɛre bebree kuraa abufuo adeɛ a wɔasiesie ama ɔsɛeɛ no mu, sɛ ɔbɛma wɔahunu n’animuonyam ahonya nso mmɔborɔhunu adeɛ a wɔasiesie ama animuonyam no so a, wobɛka sɛn? Yɛn nso wafrɛ yɛn, ɛnyɛ Yudafoɔ nko ara mu, na amanaman mufoɔ nso.
Sɛdeɛ ɔka no Hosea nwoma mu nso sɛ:
Mɛfrɛ wɔn a wɔnyɛ me man no “me man,”
ne deɛ mannɔ no no ɔdɔfo;
na ɛbɛba sɛ faako a wɔsee wɔn sɛ: Monyɛ me man no,
ɛhɔ ara na wɔbɛfrɛ wɔn Nyankopɔn Teasefoɔ no mma.
Yesaia nso tea mu wɔ Israel ho sɛ: Sɛ Israel mma dodoɔ te sɛ mpoano anwea a, emu nkaeɛ no na wɔbɛgye wɔn nkwa; ɛfiri sɛ Awurade bɛdi n’asɛm asase so awie atwa no tiaa. Na sɛdeɛ Yesaia aka asie no:
Sɛ asafo Awurade annya mma amma yɛn a,
anka yɛayɛ sɛ Sodom, na wɔama yɛasɛ Gomora.

Enti afei yɛbɛka sɛn? Amanaman mufoɔ a wɔanti tenenee no anya tenenee, nanso ɛyɛ tenenee a ɛfiri gyidie mu; na Israel a wɔtii tenenee mmara no deɛ, wɔanto tenenee mmara no. Ɛdeɛn ntira? Ɛfiri sɛ wɔtii no sɛ ɛmfiri gyidie mu, na mmom ɛfiri nnwuma mu; ɛfiri sɛ wɔsuntii suntiboɔ no, sɛdeɛ wɔatwerɛ sɛ:
Hwɛ, mede ɔbotan bi resi Sion a ɛbɛyɛ suntiboɔ ama nnipa, ɛyɛ ɔbotan a ɛbɛma wɔn ahweaseɛ;
na obiara a ɔbɛgye no adie no anim rengu ase.

app.t1_copy: I've bookmarked passages that are important to me. I've even read the whole thing through in a year thanks to the reading plans.
app.t2_copy: I love how you are able to connect with friends and the Bible reading plans are awesome. This application helps me also to stay consistent in reading because it has reminders for the plans. It also gives me another way to come closer to God. Download this and read every day!
app.t3_copy: Great app with a wide selection of Bibles to choose from. ... The audio Bibles are also wonderful and easy to understand.
app.t4_copy: Many translations and languages available, and many that can be downloaded to read offline. Many useful features, such as the ability to make notes and bookmarks.
app.t5_copy: I love how it has a lot of versions and that there are verses of the day, devotions, plans and community. Thanks for this free app. :)
app.t6_copy: Great because there are many different versions and I could download multiple versions for offline reading. I'm able to listen to this app.
app.t7_copy: Helps me to read the bible more. Love the search and share features and the variety of ways to share. Also like the audio versions.
app.t8_copy: This is a great tool for studying from multiple translations. It's also convenient for listening to the bible when you're driving.
app.t9_copy: This is the best bible app out there. It has the word in different languages and versions for online and offline use. It has devotionals for everything you could think of. You can connect with others and ultimately learn about God and his Word.
